home.heroTag: Empowering brands towards a sustainable future
home.heroDescription: We design custom reusable fabric bags that replace single-use plastics and turn your customers into mobile brand exposure. Each bag acts as a sustainable, reusable billboard with your logo — in use again and again, long after the purchase.
home.aboutTitle: Sustainable growth solutions for shops and brands
home.aboutDescription: Our mission is to replace single-use packaging with reusable fabric bags that people actually want to use. We help brands stay visible in everyday life — on the street, at work, in the gym and in supermarkets — while reducing plastic waste and promoting responsible consumption.
home.counterBagsDescription: We complete a growing number of projects every year!
home.counterSatisfactionDescription: We do our best to build lasting relationships. Your satisfaction is what matters most — every step of the way.
home.processSubtitle: From idea to delivery — made simple
home.step1Description: We get to know your brand and target audience, and how bags will be used — in stores, at events, giveaways, or e-commerce.
home.step2Description: Our team creates bag designs with your logo, colors, and message. You approve the final design before production.
home.step3Description: We produce your reusable bags with consistent printing, strong stitching, and durable materials.
home.step4Description: The bags are delivered to your address, ready to be given to your customers — so every bag becomes free advertising for your brand.

about.heroSubtitle: Solutions for shops and brands — local and international
about.heroDescription: A durable alternative to single-use plastics. For shops, takeaway, and retail. Direct from the manufacturer.
about.certDescription: EU-approved packaging — sustainable bags that boost your visibility. We deliver high quality and a scalable supply chain. Together we create reusable solutions that build your brand — and make it visible across Europe.
about.solutionSubtitle: Nordic Atlas Packaging custom packaging — on your terms
about.solution1Description: EU-approved production direct from the manufacturer. Consistent quality and scalable solutions.
about.solution2Description: We prioritize cleaner materials and responsible sourcing. Packaging that meets modern sustainability requirements — without compromising on function.
about.solution3Description: Clear timelines, fast delivery, and direct contact — from first dialogue to finished product.
about.portfolio1Description: Durable, reusable bags designed for restaurants, grocery chains, and food delivery services.
about.portfolio2Description: Reusable premium bags for clothing brands, shops, bookstores, and events.
about.portfolio3Description: Clean, branded bags for conferences, hotels, trade shows, product launches, and marketing campaigns.
about.portfolio4Description: Sustainability from the source. Renewable energy, skilled craftsmanship, and better bags.
about.whyChooseTitle: Creating a more sustainable Scandinavia is at the core of Nordic Atlas' mission
about.whyChooseCounter: From small shops to large retail chains — businesses like yours choose us.
about.process1Description: We finalize design, branding, graphic placement, materials, sizes, and print method. Once approved, the order goes into production with a fixed timeline.
about.process2Description: Your bags go into production. We produce samples for approval first, before full production continues. Every step is quality checked.
about.process3Description: When production is complete, the order is securely packed and shipped directly to your delivery address. Tracking and all export documents are included.
about.faq1Question: What materials are your bags made of?
about.faq1Answer: We use non-woven polypropylene (PP), cotton blends, and other reusable materials — depending on your needs. All materials are EU-approved, durable, and fully customizable.
about.faq2Question: Can I get bags with my own logo and design?
about.faq2Answer: Yes. We offer full customization including logo, colors, graphics, print finish, and sizes. Our design team helps with mockups so your look is consistent across all orders.
about.faq3Question: What is the minimum order quantity?
about.faq3Answer: Our standard minimum order is typically 3,000–5,000 units, depending on the model and level of customization. Larger quantities mean lower unit prices.
about.faq4Question: How long is the production and delivery time?
about.faq4Answer: Production typically takes 10–18 days, followed by 7–14 days of delivery, depending on destination and shipping method. You always get a clear timeline upfront.
about.faq5Question: Do you offer samples before mass production?
about.faq5Answer: Yes. We offer both digital samples and physical pre-production samples by arrangement, so you can approve materials, print, and sizes before production begins.
